rows.title: You Trust, We Care: Compassionate Fertility & Motherhood Excellence
rows.author: Dr. G. Sindhu (MS OBGYN)
rows.summary: At Sreemantha Hospital, every patient's trust is honored with dedicated medical excellence, empathetic clinical guidance, and personalized fertility and maternity care in Khammam.
rows.content:
Trust is the cornerstone of every healing relationship. When couples embark on their journey towards parenthood, the emotional and physical aspects require profound understanding and clinical expertise. At Sreemantha Hospital, our guiding principle is simple yet resolute: "You Trust, We Care".

Why Compassionate Care Matters

From initial fertility consultations to advanced IVF and delivery, our multidisciplinary team of obstetricians, embryologists, and neonatologists walk alongside every family. We provide transparent counseling, personalized treatment protocols, and world-class cleanroom lab standards to ensure the highest success rates with maximum comfort.

rows.title: Let Wonderful Things Happen: Transforming Dreams of Parenthood into Reality
rows.author: Clinical Embryology Team
rows.summary: Overcoming fertility challenges with modern reproductive medicine, advanced blastocyst culture, and compassionate clinical expertise.
rows.content:
Every hopeful parent's dream is precious. At Sreemantha Hospital, our advanced fertility unit is engineered to make wonderful things happen for couples navigating infertility.

Advanced Reproductive Technologies Available

  • Class 10,000 Modular IVF Embryology Lab with HEPA and VOC filtration
  • Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI) for severe male factor cases
  • Blastocyst Culture (Day 5) for superior embryo viability and implantation
  • Laser Assisted Hatching & Cryopreservation

Our dedicated fertility specialists tailor each protocol to match individual ovarian reserve, hormonal profiles, and genetic parameters.

rows.title: Happiness is Hearing Your Baby’s First Cry: What to Expect During Safe Delivery
rows.author: Dr. G. Sindhu (MS OBGYN)
rows.summary: The miraculous moment of childbirth: how Sreemantha Hospital ensures painless delivery, maternal safety, and immediate neonatal bonding.
rows.content:
There is no sound more joyful and reassuring in the world than a newborn baby's first vigorous cry. It signifies the commencement of new life and the triumphant culmination of months of maternal care.

Ensuring a Safe, Memorable Childbirth

At Sreemantha Hospital, our labor and delivery suites are integrated directly with modular operating rooms and our Level-III NICU. We provide:

  • 24/7 Painless Normal Delivery (Epidural Analgesia) administered by expert anesthesiologists
  • Continuous Electronic Fetal Heart Rate Monitoring (CTG)
  • Immediate Skin-to-Skin Kangaroo Mother Care and lactation support
  • Emergency C-Section Readiness within 15 minutes for high-risk obstetric cases

rows.title: For Us Every Child Birth is Special and Memorable: Personalized Maternity Suites
rows.author: Obstetric Nursing Team
rows.summary: Celebrating every birth with dignity, warmth, and clinical precision in our modern maternity suites in Khammam.
rows.content:
Childbirth is a milestone that stays in a mother's heart for lifetime. Recognizing this, Sreemantha Hospital transforms the clinical hospital experience into an empowering, celebratory journey.

Our private maternity suites are thoughtfully designed to balance clinical safety with domestic warmth. With 24/7 obstetric monitoring, dedicated nursing staff, and round-the-clock neonatologist availability, mothers and families experience absolute peace of mind.

rows.title: Follow Your Baby’s Cues: Essential Signs Every New Parent Should Recognize
rows.author: Dr. B. V. N. Krishna (MD Pediatrics, Neonatologist)
rows.summary: Dr. B. V. N. Krishna explains the vital non-verbal cues newborns use to communicate hunger, sleepiness, colic discomfort, and clinical warning signs.
rows.content:
Newborn babies communicate continuously through subtle behavioral and physical cues. Learning to read these cues helps parents respond promptly and prevents parental anxiety.

Common Baby Cues Decoded

  • Early Hunger Cues: Lip smacking, head turning (rooting reflex), hands brought to mouth. Crying is a late hunger cue!
  • Sleepiness Cues: Yawning, looking away, rubbing eyes, stiffening limbs.
  • Colic / Gas Cues: Clenched fists, pulling legs towards the tummy, arching back during or after feeding.

When to Seek Immediate Medical Evaluation

Contact our pediatric emergency department immediately if you notice lethargy, poor sucking, breathing difficulties (chest indrawing), persistent vomiting, or body temperature above 100.4°F.

rows.title: Fertility Impacts Men & Women of All Ages: Breaking Infertility Myths with Science
rows.author: Fertility & Andrology Specialists
rows.summary: Infertility affects both partners equally. Discover how timely diagnostic evaluations and lifestyle modifications improve conception chances.
rows.content:
A prevalent misconception in society is that infertility is predominantly a female concern. Medical science unequivocally shows that approximately 40% of infertility factors are male-related, 40% female-related, and 20% combined or unexplained.

Key Factors Affecting Fertility

  • Age & Ovarian Reserve: Anti-Müllerian Hormone (AMH) and Antral Follicle Count (AFC) assessments.
  • Sperm Quality Parameters: Semen analysis testing count, motility, and normal morphology.
  • Lifestyle Factors: Smoking, alcohol, endocrine disruptors, obesity, and chronic stress.

Early evaluation enables targeted, less invasive treatments like ovulation tracking and IUI before progressing to IVF if required.

rows.title: Embrace Good Health & Happiness for Your Child: Complete Pediatric Wellness Guide
rows.author: Dr. G. Latha (MD Paediatrics)
rows.summary: Essential guidelines for child immunization schedules, balanced nutritional milestones, and cognitive growth from infancy to school age.
rows.content:
A healthy child is a happy child. Pediatric wellness extends beyond treating illness to proactive preventive healthcare, timely vaccinations, and balanced emotional growth.

Key Pillars of Pediatric Wellness

  • Immunization Adherence: Strict compliance with the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) vaccination schedule protecting against polio, measles, rotavirus, pneumococcus, and MMR.
  • Milestone Tracking: Regular developmental assessments measuring motor skills, language acquisition, and social interaction.
  • Nutrition & Hydration: Exclusive breastfeeding for the first 6 months, followed by wholesome age-appropriate complementary foods.

rows.title: Beat Male Infertility: Modern Medical Solutions to Becoming a Father
rows.author: Andrology Department
rows.summary: Exploring clinical breakthroughs in treating male infertility including lifestyle reversal, medical therapies, TESA, and ICSI.
rows.content:
Male factor infertility is increasingly prevalent due to sedentary lifestyles, environmental pollutants, and metabolic imbalances. Fortunately, modern reproductive medicine offers powerful clinical pathways for men to achieve biological fatherhood.

Modern Treatment Options

  • Medical Therapy: Antioxidant regimens and hormonal balance correction for oligospermia.
  • Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI): Selecting a single healthy sperm for direct egg fertilization.
  • Testicular Sperm Aspiration (TESA / PESA): Surgical sperm retrieval for obstructive azoospermia.

rows.name: Multi-Specialty Hospital Infrastructure & Reception
rows.short_description: Modern 5-floor clinical campus in Khammam with spacious waiting lobbies, 24/7 pharmacy, and emergency desks.
rows.description: Sreemantha Hospital's campus is purpose-built to provide a welcoming, serene, and clinically sterile environment for women, mothers, and children. Features centralized air-handling units, dedicated triage, and seamless digital registration desks.

rows.name: 24/7 Level-III Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
rows.short_description: Khammam's premier tertiary neonatal center equipped with multi-zone incubators and round-the-clock neonatologists.
rows.description: Our Level-III NICU is engineered to provide life-saving care to extremely premature neonates and critically ill newborns. Equipped with advanced GE Giraffe and Dräger incubators, LED phototherapy, and high-frequency ventilators.

rows.name: Ultra-Clean Modular Operation Theatres
rows.short_description: Class 10,000 laminar airflow surgical suites equipped with 4K Karl Storz laparoscopy towers for maternity and gynecology.
rows.description: Designed to international surgical standards with seamless anti-bacterial surfaces, laminar airflow, and HEPA air filtration. Capable of handling complex emergency C-sections within 15 minutes, radical pelvic surgeries, and microscopic fertility operations.

rows.name: Maternity Patient Experience & Postnatal Suites
rows.short_description: Dedicated maternity floor, luxury postnatal recovery suites, and compassionate patient care counselors.
rows.description: At Sreemantha Hospital, welcoming a new baby is celebrated with dignity and happiness. Our maternity suites provide quiet, supportive recovery environments for new mothers and their newborn babies with immediate bedside assistance.

rows.question: What is the IVF success rate at Sreemantha Hospital Khammam?
rows.answer: Our cumulative IVF pregnancy success rate stands at 78% for women under 35, achieved through our advanced modular embryology laboratory, routine day-5 blastocyst culture, and individualized stimulation regimens supervised by senior specialists.

rows.question: How do I know if I need IUI or IVF?
rows.answer: During your initial consultation, we conduct an ultrasound follicular scan, tubal patency evaluation, and semen analysis. Couples with open tubes and mild male factor challenges often begin with gentle IUI, whereas severe sperm issues, blocked tubes, or repeated IUI failures benefit from IVF or ICSI.

rows.question: What is painless delivery, and is it safe for my baby?
rows.answer: Painless delivery utilizes labor epidural analgesia administered by experienced consultant anesthetists. It relieves the severe contractions pain while allowing you to remain fully conscious and physically active to push. Clinical studies confirm it is safe for both mother and infant.

rows.question: When is a newborn admitted to the Level III NICU?
rows.answer: Babies born prematurely (before 36 weeks), with birth weights under 2.0 kg, respiratory distress, severe jaundice, infection, or difficult deliveries requiring observation receive immediate round-the-clock intensive care in our Level III NICU.

rows.question: Which health insurance policies and TPAs offer cashless treatment here?
rows.answer: We offer cashless hospitalization with Star Health, HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, Medi Assist, Vidal Health, Care Health, Niva Bupa, and Bajaj Allianz. We also assist with Telangana State Government EHS and Aarogyasri protocols. Our insurance desk manages documentation directly.

rows.question: What are the consultation timings and how do I book an appointment?
rows.answer: OPD operates Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, and Sunday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Emergency services, maternity casualty, and Level III NICU operate 24 hours every day. You can book online through this website or call +91 96667 81779.

rows.title: Obstetrics & High-Risk Pregnancy Care
rows.short_description: Comprehensive prenatal care, painless labor management, and 24/7 tertiary maternal-fetal critical care in Khammam.
rows.overview: Sreemantha Hospital's Obstetrics department is led by Dr. G. Sindhu (MS OBGYN, Osmania Medical College). Our dedicated labor suites and modular operating theatres are equipped for complex maternal emergencies, twins/multiple gestations, gestational diabetes, pre-eclampsia, and prior cesarean deliveries.

rows.title: Gynecology & Advanced 3D/4K Laparoscopic Surgery
rows.short_description: Minimally invasive keyhole surgeries, fibroid removals, endometriosis excision, and complete female wellness.
rows.overview: Advanced gynecological surgical care featuring ultra-high-definition 4K laparoscopy and hysteroscopy. Patient benefits include minimal incision scars, negligible blood loss, rapid post-op recovery, and same-day or next-day discharge.

rows.title: Fertility & Reproductive Medicine (IVF / ICSI)
rows.short_description: Class 10,000 modular embryology cleanroom, Day-5 blastocyst culture, ICSI, and individualized fertility protocols.
rows.overview: Comprehensive fertility solutions helping couples fulfill their parenthood dreams. We combine rigorous genetic assessment, optimized ovulation stimulation, advanced sperm preparation, and meticulous embryo culture.

rows.title: Pediatrics & Level-III Neonatal Intensive Care (NICU)
rows.short_description: 24/7 Level-III NICU with multi-zone incubators, servo-controlled warmers, high-frequency ventilators, and expert neonatologists.
rows.overview: Led by Dr. B. V. N. Krishna (MD Pediatrics, VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital Delhi, Fellow in Neonatology), our Level-III NICU provides life-saving tertiary care for preterm infants born as early as 26 weeks, low birth weight babies, and critical neonates.

rows.story: After 7 years of heartbreaking negative tests across Hyderabad hospitals, we met Dr. Sreemantha Rao. His calm reassurance and the advanced lab in Khammam blessed us with twin baby boys on our very first IVF cycle.

Our daughter was born at just 29 weeks weighing 1.1 kilograms. Dr. Vamsi Krishna and the NICU nursing staff cared for her like their own child for 42 days. Today she is a healthy, cheerful 1-year-old baby girl.

Dr. Shravani made my entire maternity journey wonderful. The epidural painless delivery was completely peaceful, and the postnatal nursing team supported us with breastfeeding from the very first hour.

rows.title: IVF (In Vitro Fertilization) & Blastocyst Culture
rows.short_description: State-of-the-art fertilization in our Class 10,000 embryology cleanroom with Day-5 blastocyst transfer.
rows.overview: In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) is the gold-standard assisted reproductive technology where eggs and sperm are fertilized in our advanced embryology lab. Embryos are cultured until the blastocyst stage (Day 5) to maximize implantation success.
rows.how_it_works:
1. Initial Clinical Assessment: Comprehensive hormonal & ultrasound evaluation
  2. Ovarian Stimulation: Monitored protocol tailored to ovarian reserve
  3. Egg Retrieval: Ultrasound-guided painless procedure
  4. Embryo Transfer: Single blastocyst ultrasound guided transfer
who_requires: Couples with bilateral blocked or damaged fallopian tubes
Women with diminished ovarian reserve or advanced maternal age
Couples who have experienced failed IUI cycles
Severe endometriosis affecting egg quality or tubal motility
rows.preparation: Comprehensive hormonal testing (AMH, FSH, LH), baseline pelvic ultrasound, and partner semen analysis.
rows.aftercare: Progesterone luteal support, avoidance of strenuous lifting for 48 hours, and pregnancy blood test after 14 days.

rows.title: Painless Normal Delivery (Labor Epidural Analgesia)
rows.short_description: 24/7 labor epidural analgesia enabling smooth, comfortable normal vaginal delivery with continuous fetal monitoring.
rows.overview: Painless delivery utilizes continuous labor epidural analgesia administered by experienced consultant anesthesiologists. It significantly reduces labor pain while allowing the mother to remain alert and fully in control during pushing.
how_it_works: 1. Active Labor Assessment: Epidural is administered once labor is well established at 3-4 cm dilation.
2. Fine Epidural Catheter Placement: Micro-dosed local anesthetic is delivered into the epidural space.
3. Pain Relief within 10-15 Minutes: Contractions continue normally without agonizing labor pain.
4. Monitored Normal Birth: Continuous CTG fetal heartbeat tracking ensures optimal baby oxygenation.
who_requires: Expectant mothers desiring a comfortable normal vaginal delivery
Mothers with low pain tolerance seeking to avoid elective surgical cesareans
Patients with mild pregnancy-induced hypertension where stress reduction is beneficial
rows.preparation: Pre-anesthesia checkup during the third trimester, normal coagulation profile, and informed consent.
rows.aftercare: Immediate postpartum skin-to-skin bonding, initial breastfeeding within 30 minutes, and rapid mobilization within 4 hours.

rows.title: Level-III Neonatal Intensive Care (NICU)
rows.short_description: Tertiary care for preterm infants, respiratory distress, low birth weight, and surgical neonates led by Dr. B. V. N. Krishna.
rows.overview: Our Level-III NICU is the most advanced neonatal critical care facility in Khammam. Equipped with servo-controlled multi-zone incubators, LED phototherapy, continuous invasive and non-invasive cardiopulmonary monitoring, and neonatal resuscitation units.
how_it_works: 1. Rapid Resuscitation & Golden Hour Care: Immediate specialized stabilization at delivery.
2. Advanced Respiratory Support: Gentle CPAP, High-Frequency Ventilation, and Surfactant therapy.
3. Total Parenteral Nutrition (TPN): Precise intravenous nutrition for premature gastrointestinal systems.
4. Developmental Supportive Care: Noise/light control and Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC).
who_requires: Premature infants born before 37 weeks (down to 26 weeks)
Low birth weight babies weighing under 1500g or 1000g
Newborns with respiratory distress, meconium aspiration, or neonatal jaundice
Infants needing urgent neonatal medical stabilization
rows.preparation: Antenatal maternal corticosteroid administration when preterm delivery is anticipated.
rows.aftercare: Lactation counseling for expressed breast milk, transition to Kangaroo Mother Care, and follow-up developmental pediatric clinic.

rows.title: ICSI (Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection) & Male Fertility
rows.short_description: Micro-surgical injection of a single selected sperm directly into an egg for severe male factor infertility.
rows.overview: Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI) revolutionizes male infertility treatment. Using Narishige high-magnification micromanipulators, our embryologist selects the single most morphologically sound sperm and injects it directly into the egg cytoplasm.
how_it_works: 1. Advanced Semen Processing: Isolating progressive, healthy sperm.
2. Oocyte Denudation: Preparing mature eggs for micro-injection.
3. Micro-Injection: Precision insertion under 400x magnification inverted microscope.
4. Blastocyst Incubation: Culturing fertilized zygotes under strict environmental controls.
who_requires: Men with very low sperm count (severe oligospermia)
Men with poor sperm motility (asthenospermia) or abnormal shape (teratospermia)
Surgical sperm retrieval cases (TESA / PESA for azoospermia)
Previous poor or failed fertilization with conventional IVF
rows.preparation: Detailed semen analysis, DNA fragmentation index, and partner ovum pick-up coordination.
rows.aftercare: Embryo freezing or blastocyst transfer protocol as recommended by the clinical team.

rows.title: IUI (Intrauterine Insemination)
rows.short_description: Minimally invasive first-line fertility treatment placing concentrated, highly motile sperm directly into the uterus.
rows.overview: Intrauterine Insemination (IUI) is a gentle, first-line fertility procedure where processed, active sperm is placed directly inside the uterine cavity near the time of ovulation.
how_it_works: 1. Ovulation Induction & Follicular Tracking: Mild stimulation and transvaginal ultrasound scans.
2. Trigger Injection: HCG/GnRH trigger administered when follicle reaches optimal 18-20mm maturity.
3. Sperm Wash & Capacitation: Processing the sample to concentrate the fastest moving sperm.
4. Gentle Insemination: Painless 5-minute procedure placing sperm into the uterus with a soft catheter.
who_requires: Couples with unexplained infertility of 1-3 years duration
Mild male factor motility issues
Cervical mucus hostility or hostility factors
Ovulatory dysfunction treated with mild stimulation
rows.preparation: Confirmed tubal patency via HSG / laparoscopy and healthy semen parameters.
rows.aftercare: Rest for 15-20 minutes following the procedure; normal daily activities resumed immediately.

rows.title: Advanced 3D/4K Gynecological Laparoscopy
rows.short_description: Minimally invasive keyhole surgery for fibroids, ovarian cysts, and endometriosis with rapid recovery.
rows.overview: Our surgical suite features ultra-modern Karl Storz 4K laparoscopic imaging. Surgeries are performed through tiny 5mm-10mm keyhole incisions, eliminating large abdominal scars and dramatically reducing recovery time.
how_it_works: 1. High-Definition Visualization: 4K optical magnification identifies minute pathology.
2. Precision Tissue Dissection: Ultrasonic and bipolar energy instruments minimize bleeding.
3. Pathology Excision: Fibroids (myomectomy), ovarian cysts, or endometriosis cleared cleanly.
4. Aesthetic Closure: Dissolvable sub-cuticular sutures leave almost unnoticeable marks.
who_requires: Women with symptomatic uterine fibroids causing heavy bleeding or pain
Patients with large ovarian cysts or dermoid cysts
Severe endometriosis causing pelvic pain or infertility
Ectopic pregnancy or fertility enhancing tubal evaluation
rows.preparation: Routine pre-operative blood profile, fasting for 6 hours prior to surgery.
rows.aftercare: Ambulation on the same evening, oral fluids within 6 hours, discharge within 24 to 48 hours.
